about: ws-dealer-uniform pins (2026-10-24, lane S1 builder A). Real findings on APPROVED skills, pinned so the gate stays green until their dealers get the page cap: neither generateSubPair/_subOnesBorrow nor generateAddPair/_splitOnesCarry caps a page, so the default 6-page run prints one minuend (or first addend) three times on a page of 20 - the observation critic pilot-su-c r2 N1 counts as the dealer defect ('79 three times'; the fix caps a page at 2 copies of any minuend). Keys are a finding's text up to its first ' ('. Remove a key when the dealer is fixed (the tool reports a pinned key it no longer finds).
